messages.subject: Update: Web-Based Graphing
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm just writing to update everyone about the web-based graphing proposal for Summer of Code. As you know, I didn't end up submitting a proposal, but this has been on my mind and I decided to build a simple prototype.

You can see some examples, code, and a package itself here: http://www.techpolicy.ca/?p=83

I'd love to hear your thoughts and comments.

Thanks,
Wojciech
